colors.name: ink
colors.role: background — pure black, the inside of a closed magazine; every paper tone reads against it

colors.name: paper
colors.role: primary text and section titles — warm off-white, the uncoated stock (16.0:1 on ink)

colors.name: gold
colors.role: the one rare accent: the masthead underline, the look-number tick, the focus hairline, ::selection — used four times on the whole page, never more (5.5:1 on ink; large type + hairlines only)

colors.name: paper-dim
colors.role: secondary text — paper composited to 56% over ink (≈6.9:1); eyebrows, folios, captions, every Korean gloss in a display setting

colors.name: paper-quiet
colors.role: tertiary text — paper composited to ~32% over ink (≈4.6:1); the smallest folio numerals and meta, AA body minimum held

colors.name: panel
colors.role: lifted ink — the editorial spread frames and the lookbook stage; one step off pure black so hairlines read

fonts.role: Latin Didone display — the cover masthead, look numbers, section titles, pull quotes; weights 400/500/700/900 + italic for the editor's letter
all Hangul and all body text; hangul in a display setting falls through Bodoni into it

texture: No raster imagery anywhere — deliberate, and the entry's thesis. Every "photograph" is a CSS-gradient editorial block: silk is a vertical bone-to-ink gradient under a diagonal gold light; wool is horizontal noise-free grays; organza is a radial wash; the trench is a wide diagonal with a single gold seam; the gown is a near-black field with a paper spine. Frames are 1px paper-alpha hairlines on lifted ink, never borders. The only light on the page is a faint radial paper wash behind the masthead and one gold underline. No grain, no scanlines, no shadows except the single hairline rules.

motion.name: ease-spread
motion.value: cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1) — the masthead reveal: the curtain lifts slowly, holds, settles slowly

motion.name: masthead-stagger
motion.value: 85ms per glyph, letters lift from the baseline over 720ms ease-spread; the masthead opens like a cover being set down

motion.name: lookbook-pin
motion.value: section height 420vh, sticky inner pinned 100vh; --atelier-page (0→1, lerp 0.14) drives the 5-look crossfade — opacity + a 1.5% scale, never layout

motion.name: page-lerp
motion.value: 0.14 per 60fps-normalized frame — the page never snaps, it turns

motion.name: clip-reveal
motion.value: 820ms ease-spread, inset(0 0 100% 0) → inset(0), 80ms observer-batch stagger; the editorial wipe rises like a curtain

motion.name: folio-drift
motion.value: the fixed folio crossfades paper↔paper-quiet at a 5.4s sine — the only ambient motion on the page, the magazine breathing on the table
